content.comment_body: Hello, I want to set a time range for a timer's on or off delay, for example between 10 and 50 seconds. The goal is to make sure that when someone changes the timer parameter, it never goes below 10 seconds or above 50 seconds.
There's not much detail provided here. How do you want to adjust the timer value? Through the [product_name] system or the operator display? Using the web interface, an HMI, or remotely?
Thank you for your response. I want to change the timer settings using the [product_name] interface.

Hello [user_name], I see two ways forward. One method uses input validation, with the display indicating whether the chosen value is inside or outside the allowed range. If it's outside, the timer function is blocked (example 1). The other approach is using interface buttons (like UP and DOWN) to set the value, potentially enhanced with a 'Push and Hold' feature (example 2). In both options, time is entered in seconds (e.g. 1 minute 30 seconds equals 90 seconds). Kind regards, [user_name] (translated with Google)
Here’s another alternative solution you can consider.
@[user_name]: Unfortunately, the up/down controls are only available on a dedicated cursor screen, so it’s not easy to see exactly which value is being set.

Hello [user_name], I think there's a minor issue with your current program. If someone modifies the value within the valid range, the new value isn't accepted properly. Kind regards, [user_name] (translated with Google)
Yes, you're correct. In fact, it's a significant bug. Here’s an updated and fixed version.

analysis.insight_summary: Participants discussed methods to restrict timer settings on a [product_name] device so users can only set values between 10 and 50 seconds. While there’s an expectation for straightforward enforcement of limits, challenges include unclear value adjustments via interface buttons unless on a special settings page, as well as bugs with accepting new values. User experience concerns relate to input clarity and reliable enforcement of value limits.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a simple and reliable mechanism for setting timer values only within allowed limits, using the [product_name] interface, with clear and immediate feedback indicating the selected value.
